serviceMigration.title: Service update required
serviceMigration.message: An older Clash Verge service installation was detected. Reinstall it to use the current secure IPC protocol, or continue with Sidecar for this session.
serviceMigration.checkingMessage: Checking the system service status and current running mode. Please wait…
serviceMigration.unavailableMessage: The required Clash Verge service is not available. Install or repair it, or continue with Sidecar for this session.
serviceMigration.success: The Clash Verge service was updated successfully

errors.stateRefreshFailed: Failed to refresh the service state
errors.revalidationFailed: Failed to refresh the running state

sysproxyPrivilege.title: Could not set the system proxy
sysproxyPrivilege.message: macOS refused the change for lack of privileges. Installing the Clash Verge service lets it make proxy changes as an administrator, and this prompt will not come back.
sysproxyPrivilege.serviceReadyMessage: The Clash Verge service is ready, but the core is still running as a sidecar, which is why setting the system proxy was refused. Switching to service mode fixes it — no reinstall needed.
sysproxyPrivilege.alternative: Alternatively, turn off “require an administrator password to access system-wide settings” in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Advanced.

errors.restartCoreStopFailed: The core could not be stopped safely, so the restart was cancelled
errors.quitCoreStopFailed: The core could not be stopped safely, so quitting was cancelled
